problem: Post-ATP packaged output feeds the bare GPU die, which then feeds GPU Package.
recommended_action: Use fabricated bare die as GPU Package input; connect ATP output to the packaged-device node.

problem: Submitted die names GDDR6/GDDR6X while the repository reference is RTX 5080-class with GDDR7.
recommended_action: Choose generic GDDR family or use GDDR7 throughout and source a matching package structure.

problem: Alternative materials and process options are all labeled necessary_input_for.
recommended_action: Represent alternatives with OR/eligibility groups and mandatory simultaneous inputs with AND groups before min-cut or lead-time analysis.

problem: Generic soda-lime glass has been assigned to all semiconductor photomasks.
recommended_action: Use a technology-specific DUV/EUV mask-blank reference and actual required substrate/coating.

problem: YAG phosphor is treated as necessary for RGB LED.
recommended_action: Make phosphor dependent on white/phosphor-converted LED design; source the selected LED package.

problem: InGaN/AlInGaP and GaAs are named, but no raw gallium/indium nodes exist in the submitted raw-material set.
recommended_action: Review elemental inputs and compound-semiconductor chain; graph reachability alone does not establish chemical completeness.

problem: Many edges jump from ore directly to a high-purity chemical, wire or plated product.
recommended_action: Keep as ancestry links or insert refining/synthesis/purification steps. Do not use them as observed direct shipments.

problem: Several nodes combine different saleable products, grades or materials with slash/and labels.
recommended_action: Split procurement alternatives or specify which branch each supplier and factory supports.

problem: Finished-device capability does not establish separately sold bare die or unfinished component bodies.
recommended_action: Model in-house production at the parent manufacturer where relevant; independently qualify bare-part suppliers if needed.

problem: Publicly listed company sites may not manufacture the required grade/product. Legacy HBM sites do not establish GDDR production.
recommended_action: Require product-class site evidence and qualification; use vendor_site_coverage to distinguish company-level site matches.

problem: Nearby airports may have passenger service only; WPI ports can include unsuitable terminals.
recommended_action: Confirm cargo acceptance, customs, operating status and feasible land access before routing.

problem: Many coordinates are city/district proxies or inherited approximations.
recommended_action: Retain coordinate_precision and obtain factory-gate coordinates before operational routing.

problem: Provider presence and up-to-ten supplier count do not measure market coverage or qualified redundancy.
recommended_action: Add independent market-share evidence with product definition/year, or report a sample of documented providers.
